Hi Sam — thanks for the quick sample, that helps. Short answers below and then a proposed short-term flow so you can go live without blocking current AP batch runs.

What we prefer (long term):
- Portal-first for production — stronger idempotency, automatic PO binding, and richer remittance fields.
- For new activations we can accept email for the first 2 invoice cycles while we complete portal setup.

If using email (short-term fallback):
- Please use subject: INVOICE:TILTWARE:PO-RW-23456
- Filename convention we will match on: TiltWare_INV_{invoice-number}_PO-RW-23456.pdf
- Place PO number in the header field "PO" and on the first invoice line; our ingestion will try both.
- Send to invoices@redwood.com and add procurement@tiltware.com on CC so we have a visible audit trail.

Onboarding form:
- Yes, please complete the onboarding form (we attached a copy). That confirms remit-to, tax details, and payment entity mapping. We can provision your portal account once that form is returned.

Action items (internal): Jordan, can you confirm the email subject token will route to the right ledger and attach sample mapping to this thread? Kimberly, please confirm SLA for acknowledgement (we typically send an ACK within 24 hours) and whether operations needs additional headers.

Sam — copying next steps below to make it explicit: 
1) TiltWare completes and returns the onboarding form (we attached v2) — Evelyn's team will provision portal access.
2) For now send invoices to invoices@redwood.com with the subject token above. We'll monitor the first two cycles and then move you to portal-only.

Regards,
